description: Source file for CanvasWindowController, a class managing a macOS window with embedded WebView for the OpenClaw project. Contains initialization, loading, and interaction logic for the web-based canvas interface.

classes.name: CanvasWindowController
classes.description: A macOS window controller managing a WebView for rendering and interacting with a canvas in the OpenClaw project. Handles loading URLs/files, configuring the WebView, message handling, and window behaviors.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the CanvasWindowController, sets up WebView, configuration, message handlers, and file watcher.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Cleans up message handlers and stops the file watcher.

methods.name: applyPreferredPlacement
methods.description: Sets the preferred placement for the window.

methods.name: showCanvas
methods.description: Shows the canvas window, optionally loading a specific path.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a given URL or file path into the WebView, handling different URL schemes and local paths.

methods.name: updateDebugStatus
methods.description: Updates the debugging overlay/status indicators in the WebView.

methods.name: applyDebugStatusIfNeeded
methods.description: Applies the debug status overlay if enabled.

methods.name: loadFile
methods.description: Loads a local file URL into the WebView.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates JavaScript code within the WebView and returns the result.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Takes a snapshot screenshot of the WebView and saves it as a PNG file.

methods.name: directoryPath
methods.description: Returns the file system path to the session directory.

methods.name: shouldAutoNavigateToA2UI
methods.description: Determines if the WebView should auto-navigate based on the last target.
